statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); out="$model"; if [ -n "$used" ]; then out="$out | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")% used"; fi; quota=$(bash "$HOME/.claude/statusline-quota.sh" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$quota" ]; then out="$out | $quota"; fi; printf '%s' "$out"
